scoringPolicy.principle: Score deterministic semantic fields, numbers and booleans. Free-form rationale is evidence only and is never a required lexical match.
scoringPolicy.contract: Models are evaluated both for research correctness and for strict structured-output compliance required by the agent runtime.

cases.prompt: You maintain a research memory index. Normalize this input without inventing records: [{"id":"EXP-3","status":"REJECTED"},{"id":"EXP-1","status":"FROZEN"},{"id":"EXP-3","status":"REJECTED"},{"id":"EXP-2","status":"ACTIVE"}]. Return JSON only with exactly these keys: sortedIds, uniqueCount, rejectedIds, contractCode. sortedIds must contain ascending unique ids. contractCode must be exactly RESEARCH_MEMORY_NORMALIZED.

Research Lab scenario: Signal is MA5 crossing above MA20 on day D. RSI is 49 on D and becomes 55 on D+1. A proposed implementation applies FRESH_TRUE to the combined boolean (MA5>MA20 AND RSI>50), which can create a false new event on D+1. Diagnose and correct it. Return JSON only with exactly these keys: causalErrorCode, correctionCode, triggerEventCode, filterCode, falseSignalDay, executionReference, profitabilityClaim, rationale. Use these exact enum values when correct: causalErrorCode=TRIGGER_FILTER_CONFLATION; correctionCode=SEPARATE_TRIGGER_AND_FILTER; triggerEventCode=MA5_CROSS_UP_MA20_ON_D; filterCode=RSI_GT_50_AT_TRIGGER; falseSignalDay=D+1; executionReference=D+1_OPEN. profitabilityClaim must be false. rationale is free text and is not scored.

Baseline feature A has 100 events: 40 winners and 60 losers. Candidate filter B removes 8 winners and 30 losers. Evaluate A versus A+B without calling B profitable or validated. Return JSON only with exactly these keys: retainedWinners, removedWinners, removedLosers, remainingEvents, winnerRetentionPct, loserRemovalPct, nextValidationCode, profitabilityClaim, rationale. Calculate the numeric fields exactly. nextValidationCode must be exactly UNSEEN_CHRONOLOGICAL_OOS. profitabilityClaim must be false. rationale is free text and is not scored.

A TypeScript research function must never use future data. Given: function signal(close:number[], i:number){ return close[i+1] > close[i]; }. Return JSON only with exactly these keys: defectCode, correctedFunction, invariantCode, futureReferenceDetected, correctedUsesFuture, rationale. Use exact enum values defectCode=FUTURE_BAR_ACCESS and invariantCode=NO_FUTURE_BAR_ACCESS. futureReferenceDetected must be true and correctedUsesFuture must be false. correctedFunction must be a TypeScript function named signal that uses only close[i] and earlier indexes and must not contain i+1 or i + 1. rationale is free text and is not scored.
